quests.name: Duskrender's Trial
quests.offer: A wolf of forty seasons has earned a gift. First, prove it: Martin Flicker, a caster, haunts Mayfly Glade by the river. Kill him, then hear what Dawn Raylight and John Dewey have to say.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Defeat Martin Flicker by the fallen log near the river in Mayfly Glade (E).
Speak with Dawn Raylight in Mariel Village.
steps.says: Edward sent you? Then go on to John Dewey in Misty Thicket; he will know the rest.

steps.journal: Speak with John Dewey in Misty Thicket (NE).
steps.says: Jasmine, the bear in Surefall Glade, has grown too bold. Edward wants her dead.

steps.journal: Defeat Jasmine, the bear in the trees at the north-east end of the lake in Surefall Glade.
Return to Edward Duskrender in the druid village of Unkempt North.
steps.says: Well hunted. Take this, and use it well.

quests.name: The Hunt
quests.offer: I must speak with you. The fever is in you; I can smell it. Before it takes you, face Zaren. West of the castle, past the inn, a tower stands by the road; he waits beyond it. Or take my antidote and stay as you are.
quests.declined: Then the fever passes, and you with it. Come back if you change your mind.
quests.started: Zaren will not wait for you to be ready.

steps.journal: Defeat Zaren, beyond the tower by the road west of Castle Lightwolf, past the inn.
Return to Levandius in the druid village of Unkempt North.
steps.says: Zaren is dead and the fever has run its course. You are one of us now, wolf.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/wolfwere.json, The Hunt (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Zaren is the server's row (level 44), not the player's level; the guide's Zaran. The antidote is the decline (it changes nothing). The faction with Werehunters of Tunaria (-1000) is ours: it keeps a lycan from the werehunters' brand and the vampires' blood, as the guides say.

quests.name: Fryda's Kin
quests.offer: Brother Norton keeps watch on the road south of this castle, just past the inn, and no word has come from him in days. Find him for me. Go armed: the road is not what it was.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Brother Norton on the road south of Castle Lightwolf, just past the inn.
steps.says: Fryda sent you? Then they followed you here. Behind you!

steps.journal: Fight off the three wolfweres that set upon you at Brother Norton's.
Tell Fryda Lightwolf in Castle Lightwolf what waited at Brother Norton's.
steps.says: Wolfweres, on our own road. John Lightwolf hunts the ice plains south of Halas. Find him before they do.

steps.journal: Find John Lightwolf at the foot of a small hill in the ice plains south of Halas.
steps.says: Fryda's runner? They have my scent as well. Here they come!

steps.journal: Fight off the three wolfweres that set upon you at John Lightwolf's.
Return to Fryda Lightwolf in Castle Lightwolf.
steps.says: So the curse spreads. Levandius, in the druid village of Unkempt North, knows the wolf's blood better than anyone. Go to him.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/wolfwere.json, the first two parts (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The three each part sets on the player are wolfweres of their own level (38 to 40), not the player's: bring friends. The guide names no reward for these parts.

quests.name: Wolfwere Tails
quests.offer: The wolfweres of these woods carry the curse in their blood. Bring me four of their tails and the Night Reapers will count you a friend. Hunt the ones that are a match for you.
quests.declined: Then hunt elsewhere. The tails will keep.
quests.started: Hunt the ones that are a match for you.

steps.journal: Take four wolfwere tails from the wolfweres of Unkempt North and the Unkempt Glade.
Bring the four wolfwere tails to Levandius.
steps.says: Four tails. The Night Reapers will remember the hunter who brought them.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/wolfwere.json, the tail quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The live game's infection was a chance on killing a were that conned yellow; here it is the society's standing alone: the tail quest repeats, each four tails +250 with Night Reapers (ours), and the urgent word comes at 1000.

quests.name: The Bear's Gift
quests.offer: A bear of forty seasons can learn more. A golden gnoll, a caster and a healer, keeps south-east of the undead house at Crethley Manor. Kill it, then go to Kierra in Mariel Village.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Defeat the Golden Gnoll south-east of the undead house at Crethley Manor.
Find Kierra, the faerie at the foot of a tree ramp in Mariel Village.
steps.says: Dorandas still sends his cubs to me? Then go: a green racer snake suns itself on a hill east of the druids' lake in the Unkempt Glade.

steps.journal: Defeat the Green Racer Snake on the hill east of the druids' lake in the Unkempt Glade.
Find Briggs in the Salt Mines (C), between the Siloth dock camp and the cave entrance.
steps.says: Kierra's word is good enough for me. Go back to Dorandas; you have earned it.

steps.journal: Return to Dorandas in the druid village of Unkempt North.
steps.says: You have earned the bear's gift.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/bearwere.json, Level 40 Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's giver is "your class-specific NPC" in Unkempt North (S), unnamed: Dorandas, the line's NPC there, gives it, one quest an archetype with its spell. The return is to him, not the Unkempt Glade.

quests.name: Mirin
quests.offer: Listen to me, and quickly. The bear is in your blood now. Mirin, a caster, hunts east of the bandit village in south-western Unkempt North. Kill him and the change is yours. Or drink my antidote and forget all this.
quests.declined: Then the sickness passes. Come back if you change your mind.
quests.started: Mirin has a pet. Bring friends.

steps.journal: Defeat Mirin, just east of the bandit village in Unkempt North (SW).
Return to Dorandas in the druid village of Unkempt North.
steps.says: Mirin is gone, and the bear is yours. Welcome to the Wards of the Dawn.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/bearwere.json, the infection (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The form's spell is named as the guide's table names it (Bearwere): this server has no bear form yet, so the quest stays a draft until it does. Mirin is the seeded row's level. The antidote is the decline. The faction with Werehunters of Tunaria (-1000) is ours (see the wolfwere's).

quests.name: Paws in the Snow
quests.offer: Something prowls the woods north-east of Castle Lightwolf, toward the goblins. Walk there and let it find you. If you live, come back and tell me what it was.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Roam the woods north-east of Castle Lightwolf, toward the goblins.

events.text: A growl rolls out of the trees, and then another. Two bears are coming for you!

steps.journal: Defeat Barbiedolls Paw.
Defeat Flurry.
Return to Kiev Bearclaw by the well in the village south of Castle Lightwolf.
steps.says: Barbiedolls Paw and Flurry. They were testing you. They gather north of Anu Village too, on the blue hill with stones on top, before the observatory.

steps.journal: Search the glowing blue hill with stones on top, before the observatory north of Anu Village.

events.text: The stones on the hill glow blue. Out of the cold come the same two bears!

steps.journal: Defeat Barbiedolls Paw again.
Defeat Flurry again.
Return to Kiev Bearclaw.
steps.says: Twice now. You have their respect, and that means something. Dorandas, in the druid village of Unkempt North, will tell you what.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/bearwere.json, the first two parts (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The pop-ups' 30-minute timer is left out; the two bears come one after the other, at their seeded level (35 and 34) rather than the player's. The guide names no reward for these parts.

quests.declined: Then hunt elsewhere. The tails will keep.
quests.started: Hunt the ones that are a match for you.

steps.journal: Take four bearwere tails from the bearweres of the Unkempt woods and the North Wilderlands.
Bring the four bearwere tails to Dorandas.
steps.says: Four tails. The Wards of the Dawn will hear of it.

quests.name: The Swarm's Errands
quests.offer: A rat of forty seasons gets the swarm's errands. Start with Nunnie, by the big cyclops house east of the main gate at Urglunt's Wall. She looks angry; she will not bite.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Speak with Nunnie by the large cyclops house east of the main gate at Urglunt's Wall.
steps.says: Red in the face, am I? I do not bite. Tell the Swashbuckler I am still here.

steps.journal: Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: Good. Now Trick Trune, by the beach in the north-west of Broken Skull Rock.

steps.journal: Speak with Trick Trune by the beach at Broken Skull Rock (NW).
steps.says: The Swashbuckler's rat? Fine. Tell him the Tae Ew are moving.

steps.journal: Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: The Tae Ew, then. A trader of theirs roams Cazic Thule's north-west, and a hoarder sits on a misty hill in Tak'Xiz South. Both of them.

steps.journal: Defeat the Tae Ew Trader roaming north-western Cazic Thule.
Defeat the Tae Ew Hoarder on the small hill in green mist across the river in Tak'Xiz South.
Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: The swarm thanks you. Take what you have earned.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/ratwere.json, Level 40 Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's giver is "the appropriate class NPC in Temby", unnamed: the Shady Swashbuckler gives it, one quest an archetype with its spell (monks with the melee: the guide's list names Rogue, Bard and Ranger). quests.name: Trissen
quests.offer: I must speak with you, urgently. The swarm is in your blood. Trissen, who betrayed us, hides in Bobble-by-Water. Kill him and the change is yours. Or take my antidote and walk away.
quests.declined: Then the fever leaves you. Come back if you change your mind.
quests.started: Trissen is no easy kill. Bring friends.

steps.journal: Defeat Trissen in Bobble-by-Water.
Return to Yindrius in Freeport.
steps.says: Trissen is dead, and you are one of the swarm. Welcome.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/ratwere.json, the infection (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Trissen is the server's row (level 30), not red to the player. The antidote is the decline. The faction with Werehunters of Tunaria (-1000) is ours (see the wolfwere's).

quests.name: Debts and Favors
quests.offer: I owe a friend in Highpass Hold, a trafficker who keeps out of sight in the castle. Take him this purse. Do it right and there is more work, the kind that pays in more than coin.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Take the Swashbuckler's coin purse to the shady trafficker in Highpass castle.
steps.says: From the Swashbuckler? Good. Tell him we are square.

steps.journal: Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby's fishing village.
steps.says: Square, is it? Then go to Rathei Slaerin in Freeport, in the building west of the spiritmaster Keika.

steps.journal: Speak with Rathei Slaerin in Freeport, in the building west of Spiritmaster Keika.
steps.says: The Swashbuckler vouches for you. Yindrius will want to see you: east past the city wall, then north to the entrance, along the south side of the building.

steps.journal: Speak with Yindrius along the south side of the building past Freeport's east wall.
steps.says: So you are the one. Go back to the Swashbuckler; he has more for you.

steps.journal: Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: Rolby Rumblebelly in Muniel's Tea Garden has news for us. Hear it.

steps.journal: Speak with Rolby Rumblebelly in Muniel's Tea Garden.
steps.says: Tell the Swashbuckler that Cogwhisker is back, at the bandit camp by the lake in northern Bandit Hills.

steps.journal: Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: Cogwhisker owes the Topi. Go east from Darvar Manor into Bandit Hills and settle it.

steps.journal: Settle Cogwhisker's debt at the bandit camp by the lake in northern Bandit Hills.
Return to the Shady Swashbuckler in Temby.
steps.says: Cogwhisker, settled. You will do. Yindrius in Freeport has work for you now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/ratwere.json, the first parts (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The ambush at Highpass (two guards and another, the dealer to keep alive) is left out: the trafficker takes the purse. Cogwhisker is fought (the guide lets him be paid off instead; the engine has one path), at the server's level for him. The guide names no reward for these parts.

quests.name: Ratwere Tails
quests.offer: The wererats carry the plague of the swarm. Bring me four of their tails and the Topi di Ombra will count you a friend. Ferran's Hope crawls with them; hunt the ones that are a match for you.
quests.declined: Then hunt elsewhere. The tails will keep.
quests.started: Hunt the ones that are a match for you.

steps.journal: Take four ratwere tails from the wererats of Ferran's Hope.
Bring the four ratwere tails to Yindrius.
steps.says: Four tails. The Topi di Ombra will know your name.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/ratwere.json, the tail quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The live game's infection was a chance on killing a were that conned yellow; here it is the society's standing alone: the tail quest repeats, each four tails +250 with Topi Di Ombra (ours), and the urgent word comes at 1000. The guide's ratwere is the game's wererat.

quests.name: Katerina's Tasks
quests.offer: A lion of forty seasons has more to learn. North of the Oasis, by the first flag on the left, a small valley hides an undead slave. Destroy it and come back to me.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Defeat the Undead Slave down the small valley by the first flag on the left north of the Oasis.
Return to Katerina Suncharmer in Sondereel Village.
steps.says: Good. Now Trizzia Newmane, in the courtyard of Fort Alliance (SE), keeps the Collar of Power. Ask her for it in my name.

steps.journal: Ask Trizzia Newmane in the south-eastern courtyard of Fort Alliance for the Collar of Power.
steps.says: Katerina's name opens my hand. Here.
steps.answer:
Katerina Suncharmer sends me for the Collar of Power.
I was only passing.

steps.journal: Bring the Collar of Power to Katerina Suncharmer.
steps.says: The collar. Now Branty, by the south entrance of Merry-by-Water, across from the spiritmaster, holds the Claw of the Ancients.

steps.journal: Ask Branty, by the south entrance of Merry-by-Water, for the Claw of the Ancients.
steps.says: For Katerina? Take it, and be off.
steps.answer:
Katerina Suncharmer sends me for the Claw of the Ancients.
Nothing, thank you.

steps.journal: Bring the Claw of the Ancients to Katerina Suncharmer.
steps.says: The claw too. Last, Zipnick: behind Zentar's Keep, near the fisherman, in a stone circle with mist.

steps.journal: Defeat Zipnick in the misty stone circle behind Zentar's Keep, near the fisherman.
Return to Katerina Suncharmer in Sondereel Village.
steps.says: The pride is proud of you. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/lionwere.json, Level 40 Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One quest an archetype, each with its spell (monks with the melee: the guide's list names Rogue, Ranger and Bard). The "correct line" Trizzia and Branty want is ours: the guide does not give it. Undead Slave and Zipnick are the seeded rows' levels.

quests.name: Jensen
quests.offer: Hear me, it is urgent. The lion stirs in your blood. Jensen waits in Dark Solace, at the South Crossroads. Kill him and the change is yours. Or drink my antidote and live as you were.
quests.declined: Then the fever leaves you. Come back if you change your mind.

steps.journal: Defeat Jensen in Dark Solace, at the South Crossroads.
Return to Corindas in Sondereel Village.
steps.says: Jensen is dead and the lion is yours. Welcome, Sunmane.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/lionwere.json, the infection (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Jensen is the seeded row's level, not triggered. The antidote is the decline. The faction with Werehunters of Tunaria (-1000) is ours (see the wolfwere's).

quests.name: Lionell Redrick
quests.offer: Lionell Redrick is trapped in the Salt Mines to the west, in the first room off the spiral stair. Bring him out alive. The Siloths will not let him go quietly.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Lionell Redrick in the first room off the spiral stair in the Salt Mines (W).
steps.says: You came for me? Then we go now. They will be waiting for us.

steps.journal: Fight off the Siloths that ambush you and Lionell Redrick.
Fight off the second ambush on the way out of the mine.
Return to Burgomaster Delvin in Sondereel Village.
steps.says: Lionell is home, and Sondereel owes you. One thing more: Herman Forrestor, in a tent outside Kelinar, has been hunting our kind.

steps.journal: Find Herman Forrestor in his small tent outside Kelinar (SW).
steps.says: Sondereel sent you? Hunters, to me!

steps.journal: Defeat the three hunters at Herman Forrestor's tent.
Defeat Herman Forrestor.
Return to Burgomaster Delvin in Sondereel Village.
steps.says: Herman will hunt no one now. Corindas, here by the river, has work for one like you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/lionwere.json, the first two parts (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The escort is left out: the two ambushes (three Siloth knights each, the guide's one necromancer and two melee) come where the player stands after speaking with Lionell, and the walk to the tree is skipped. Herman's hunters are the three Werehunters at his tent. The guide names no reward for these parts.

quests.name: Lionwere Tails
quests.offer: The lionweres carry the Sunmanes' gift in their blood. Bring me four of their tails and the Sunmanes will count you a friend. Hunt the ones that are a match for you.
quests.declined: Then hunt elsewhere. The tails will keep.
quests.started: Hunt the ones that are a match for you.

steps.journal: Take four lionwere tails from the lionweres of Fort Alliance and Centaur Valley.
Bring the four lionwere tails to Corindas.
steps.says: Four tails. The Sunmanes will hear your name.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/lionwere.json, the tail quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The live game's infection was a chance on killing a were that conned yellow; here it is the society's standing alone: the tail quest repeats, each four tails +250 with Sunmanes (ours), and the urgent word comes at 1000. The guide asks 150 with the Villagers of Sonderal to log it and 1000 with the Sunmanes to finish; the standings start at 1 here and nothing else raises them, so the tails raise both.

quests.name: The Swamp's Gift
quests.offer: A gator of forty seasons can learn more. Two enemies of the swamp: Gypsy Treheart in the southern Burial Mounds, and Nullo in the north of Sycamore Joy's Rest. Kill them both.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Defeat Gypsy Treheart in the Burial Mounds (S).
Defeat Nullo at Sycamore Joy's Rest (N).
Return to The Bone Crusher in Dinbak (SE).
steps.says: Both of them. The swamp gives you this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/gatorwere.json, Level 40 Spell Quest Notes (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's three class NPCs (on Crocosaurus's island, at Fort Alliance (SE), in Taksehir city) are unnamed and left out: The Bone Crusher gives it, one quest an archetype with its spell, and the two kills are its steps. Gypsy Treheart and Nullo are the seeded rows' levels, not triggered.

quests.name: Julian
quests.offer: Listen. The swamp is in your blood now. Julian waits on a raised mound in glowing mist, in north-western Dinbak. Kill him and the change is yours. Or take the antidote and go home.
quests.declined: Then the fever leaves you. Come back if you change your mind.

steps.journal: Defeat Julian on the raised mound in glowing mist in Dinbak (NW).
Return to The Bone Crusher in Dinbak (SE).
steps.says: Julian is dead. The swamp is yours now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/gatorwere.json, the infection (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The form's spell is named as the guide's table names it (Gatorwere): this server has no gator form yet, so the quest stays a draft until it does. Julian is the seeded row's level. The antidote is the decline. The faction with Werehunters of Tunaria (-1000) is ours (see the wolfwere's).

quests.name: Liz's Father
quests.offer: My father went west into Widow's Peak and never came home. The Yaroslavs camp in three tents in the east of it. Ask them what they know. Please.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Ask Ivander Yaroslav at the three tents in Widow's Peak (E) about Liz's father.
steps.says: An old man from Blackwater? Never saw him. Ask the others if you like.

steps.journal: Ask Isabella Yaroslav at the tents.
steps.says: We keep to ourselves. Go away.

steps.journal: Ask Dimitri Yaroslav at the tents.
steps.says: Nobody came this way. Nobody.

steps.journal: Return to Liz Boglurker in Blackwater.
steps.says: They are lying, I know it. Go back and make them tell the truth.

steps.journal: Go back to the Yaroslavs' tents in Widow's Peak.
steps.says: You should have let it lie. Now you will join him!

steps.journal: Defeat Ivander Yaroslav.
Defeat Isabella Yaroslav.
Defeat Dimitri Yaroslav.
Return to Liz Boglurker in Blackwater.
steps.says: Then he is dead. Yolanda Ribisi at the Oasis knows the swamp's curse. Ask her what they did to him.

steps.journal: Speak with Yolanda Ribisi at the Oasis.
steps.says: The Yaroslavs feed the swamp's gatorweres. Your friend's father went to them. Tell her, gently.

steps.journal: Return to Liz Boglurker in Blackwater.
steps.says: Gatorweres. The Bone Crusher, in south-eastern Dinbak, knows them. Go to him.

steps.journal: Find The Bone Crusher in Dinbak (SE).
steps.says: The old man? Unga and Daraznak Vekiz took him. Two small tents north of the troll crusaders in Hazinak's north-west. Go.

steps.journal: Find Unga and Daraznak Vekiz at two small tents north of the troll crusaders' camp in Hazinak (NW).
steps.says: Asking about the old man? You will meet him soon!

steps.journal: Defeat Unga.
Defeat Daraznak Vekiz.
Tell Yolanda Ribisi at the Oasis what you have done.
steps.says: It is done, then. The Bone Crusher will want to hear it.

steps.journal: Return to The Bone Crusher in Dinbak.
steps.says: Unga and Daraznak, gone. Now you hunt for me.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/gatorwere.json, the first parts (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Yaroslavs, Unga and Daraznak "reappear as KoS": a copy of each comes for the player in turn, one after another, at the seeded rows' levels (28 to 32). The guide names no reward for these parts.

quests.name: Gatorwere Tails
quests.offer: The gatorweres carry the swamp in their blood. Bring me four of their tails and I will count you a friend. Hunt the ones that are a match for you, in Dinbak.
quests.declined: Then hunt elsewhere. The tails will keep.
quests.started: Hunt the ones that are a match for you.

steps.journal: Take four gatorwere tails from the gatorweres round Dinbak.
Bring the four gatorwere tails to The Bone Crusher.
steps.says: Four tails. Good. The swamp remembers.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/gatorwere.json, the tail quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The live game's infection was a chance on killing a were that conned yellow; here it is the society's standing alone: the tail quest repeats, each four tails +250 with The Bone Crusher (ours), and the urgent word comes at 1000. The guide names no faction for the gatorweres' 1000; The Bone Crusher's own is used. The server has no gatorwere: a few are seeded in Dinbak.

quests.name: Mistmoore
quests.offer: Mayong Mistmoore, the vampire, wants the Siloths for his own. Enrique Revnold, by the crossroads at Forkwatch, knows a song that wakes him. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Enrique Revnold by the crossroads at Forkwatch.
steps.says: My ancestor Vedel wrote a song to rouse Mistmoore. I will give you his tome, for a Writ of the Wild from the Unkempt druids.

steps.journal: Take a Writ of the Wild from the druids and rangers of the Unkempt village, where Levandius is.
Bring the Writ of the Wild to Enrique Revnold at Forkwatch.
steps.says: The songs are yours. Vedel became the Maestro of Rancor: only an instrument a vampire made can call him. Look in the vampire's lair under the salt mine.

steps.journal: Find the organ in the second room on the right past the spider-marked room, deep in the Salt Mines (SW).

events.text: You play Vedel's song on the organ. The Maestro of Rancor rises on the carpet!

steps.journal: Defeat the Maestro of Rancor and take his song page.
Find Mayong Mistmoore's stone coffin in the cavern below the brick hall, and destroy him.
Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: Mistmoore is destroyed. Take this, a hero's blessing.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/werehunter.json, Were-Hunter Ability Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One quest an archetype with its blessing and talisman. The Maestro and Mistmoore are the server's rows, where they stand (Mistmoore a rare spawn in the live game); the song page is taken but not asked for.

The Maestro and Mistmoore are the server's rows, where they stand (Mistmoore a rare spawn in the live game); the song page is taken but not asked for.

quests.name: The Siloth Shipment
quests.offer: A shipment comes to the Siloth docks, south of the cave by the river. Take what the smugglers carry: a folded parchment, and their coin purse. Then see what their chest holds.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Take a folded parchment from the blackscourge smugglers on the Siloth docks, south of the cave by the river.
Take a Siloth coin purse from the Siloth knights about the docks.
Open the magically locked chest the smugglers stood by, with the parchment's words.

events.text: You speak the parchment's words and the chest's lock gives. Inside: orders for the shipment's coin, and the name of the one it pays: a vampire.

steps.journal: Show Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis the coin purse.
steps.says: A vampire's coin. Take the purse to Marona Jofranka in Freeport.

steps.journal: Bring the coin purse to Marona Jofranka in Freeport.
steps.says: Necrologist Quenka, by the books in Klick'Anon's necromancers' guild, can read what is bound in it.

steps.journal: Bring the coin purse to Necrologist Quenka in Klick'Anon's necromancers' guild.
steps.says: There is a spirit bound in this coin. Listen to it.

events.text: A spirit rises from the coins. "Tserrina," it whispers. "The vampire on the hill north-west of the salt mine. She bought us all." Then it is gone.

steps.journal: Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: Tserrina. Her castle stands on a hill north-west of the salt mine; her coffin is on the third floor. End her.

steps.journal: Defeat Tserrina on the third floor of the castle on the hill north-west of the salt mine.
Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: Tserrina is gone. The gypsies are in your debt.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/werehunter.json, PART 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The spirit's words are a pop-up; the coffin's incantation is left out (Tserrina stands up). The guide gives only the healers' charm ("rewards will vary by class"): the other classes get the experience alone.

quests.name: The Werehunter's Brand
quests.offer: You have fought them and lived, and the gypsies trust you. Will you join the Were-Hunters? I will brand you with silver. No lycan's bite will ever take you after that.
quests.declined: The brand will wait for you.

steps.journal: Take the Were-Hunters' brand from Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: It is done. Wear this ring, and keep it: one day you will be asked to show it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/werehunter.json, PART 1's end (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The brand is +1000 with Werehunters of Tunaria (ours): the were infections and the vampires' blood are offered only below 500, and a lycan (-1000) is not offered the brand. The ring is a copy of an iron ring (the guide's L30 STR 15 INT 15 is not this server's item).

quests.name: Silver and Fur
quests.offer: Lycanthropes walk among the farmers of Hodstock. Take this silver needle: one prick shows them for what they are. A man with a pet rat keeps to a farming village in the north-west. Start there.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Prick the man with the pet rat in the farming village of Hodstock (NW) with the silver needle.
steps.says: Ow! What was... no. NO!

events.text: Slick Stevenson and his rat Bucktooth twist and swell into lycanthropes!

steps.journal: Defeat Slick Stevenson, the lycanthrope.
Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: So it is true. There is another: Lynda Elmquist, in a small building at Jethro's Pike, in the south of Jethro's Cast.

steps.journal: Find Lynda Elmquist in a small building at Jethro's Pike, in the south of Jethro's Cast.
steps.says: You smell of silver. Then you die!

steps.journal: Defeat Lynda Elmquist in her wolf's shape.
Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: Two of them. Marona Jofranka in Freeport, north of the coach by the dueling arena, hears more than I do.

steps.journal: Speak with Marona Jofranka north of the coach in Freeport, by the dueling arena.
steps.says: Djivan's hunter. Dravin Slaerin, in the merchant house east of here, has something for you.

steps.journal: Speak with Dravin Slaerin in the merchant house east of Marona Jofranka.
steps.says: Take this pouch to Necrologist Ipstock, by the river in Hazinak. Watch his face when he opens it.

steps.journal: Bring Dravin's pouch to Necrologist Ipstock by the river in Hazinak.
steps.says: Silver? You fool. You have killed yourself!

steps.journal: Defeat Necrologist Ipstock, the lycanthrope, and his swarming minion.
Return to Dravin Slaerin in Freeport.
steps.says: Ipstock too. Marona must hear this.

steps.journal: Return to Marona Jofranka in Freeport.
steps.says: A vampire is gathering undead beasts, for what I dare not guess. Go back to the Oasis and warn Djivan.

steps.journal: Warn Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: A vampire behind it all. You have done the gypsies a great service.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/werehunter.json, PART 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Slick Stevenson is the server's row (level 63, the guide's Slick Svenson; his rat Bucktooth cannot be attacked here). Lynda Elmquist, who cannot be attacked either, turns into a werewolf that comes for the player; Ipstock's swarming minion is left out. The guide's NTL drops are left out. A lycan (-1000 with Werehunters of Tunaria, ours) is not offered it.

quests.name: Hinder the Siloths
quests.offer: Lord Phinnius keeps the Siloths as his slaves' wardens in the salt mines. Hinder them in any way you can. Ten of their knights, and the Gypsies of Tunaria will know your devotion.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: The deeper you go, the more it counts.

steps.journal: Defeat ten Siloth knights in the Salt Mines.
Return to Djivan Mertshak in the Oasis.
steps.says: Well done. The gypsies will remember it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/werehunter.json, the Gypsies of Tunaria notes (and Quest Part I's words) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide gets the faction by killing Siloths (+1 near the top to +10 at the bottom of the mines); this server has no faction hits for them, so a repeatable task gives it, +75 for ten knights (ours).

quests.name: Razeal Has Won
quests.offer: Razeal has won. His filthy creatures are loose in Tunaria, bats that never stay in one place, and they carry a blood that changes you. Hunt them if you dare. Then let Grindal, at the inn, look at you.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Hunt desmodus bats, wherever their camps have sprung up across Tunaria.
Have Grindal look you over, in the inn on the left from Freeport's coach.
steps.says: Ah. The bats' gift is in your blood. You belong with us now. Come.

steps.journal: Speak with Hinder in the Sanctuary.
steps.says: You have been blessed, child. Feed, and keep your stores of blood full: everything we do costs blood.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/vampire.json, 1-3 (Logging the Quest, Infection, Level 30) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The bats' chance of infection is five kills here. Grindal's port to the Sanctuary is a teleport to the Secrets world (Sandstorm's vampires' Sanctuary is in its Zaoran Plateau; claude-notes/sanctuary-memcard-patch-20261025.md), on the open ground north of the building there. This server has no vampire ability yet (Feed, Sanctuary and the rest), so the vampire quests stay drafts until it does; the units of blood, the daylight DoT and the coffin ports are not modelled. Greddy refuses a lycan or a werehunter (Werehunters of Tunaria -1000 or +1000, ours), as the guide does; Dr. Killian's cure is left out.

quests.name: Creed's Lessons
quests.offer: Forty seasons of the night. I can teach you to take blood in a blow, and to show what you truly are. Ask, and it is yours.
quests.declined: The night is long. Come back.

steps.journal: Learn from Creed in the Sanctuary.
steps.says: Strike, and drink as you strike. And when you wish, wear your true face.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/vampire.json, 4. Level 40 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). This server has no vampire ability yet (Vampiric Strike, Vampire Form), so it stays a draft until it does.

quests.name: Weaver's Lessons
quests.offer: Fifty seasons, and you still walk like the living. Let me show you the bat's shape, and the vitality the blood gives.
quests.declined: The night is long. Come back.

steps.journal: Learn from Weaver in the Sanctuary.
steps.says: Become the bat when you must strike, and call on the blood when you must endure.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/vampire.json, 5. Level 50 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). This server has no vampire ability yet (Bat Form, Vitality), so it stays a draft until it does.

quests.name: Simmons's Lessons
quests.offer: Sixty seasons. You are ready for the last of it: the frenzy, the mist and the gaze.
quests.declined: The night is long. Come back.

steps.journal: Learn from Simmons in the Sanctuary.
steps.says: Frenzy, mist and the gaze that turns eyes away. You are a master of the night. Twelve relics lie hidden in three sets of four; the scholar who read of them vanished.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Weres/vampire.json, 6. Level 60 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). This server has no vampire ability yet (Frenzy, Mist Form, Vampiric Gaze), so it stays a draft until it does.
